children: Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE:HRL) reported Q3 sales of $2.96B and adjusted EPS $0.37 while trimming its FY27 sales guide to $12.1–12.2B amid retail and international weakness, named Ash Bhumbla as CFO, highlighted a ~4.9% yield, and rolled out SPAM Dog promotions in Minnesota.
HrL Q3 Sales Decline; FY27 Guide Cut

: HRL Q3 sales $2.96B, down ~2% YoY; GAAP EPS $0.11, adjusted EPS $0.37. Company cut FY27 sales guide to $12.1–12.2B, cited retail/international volume weakness, foodservice growth, higher inventories.

: Hormel Foods (HRL) named Ash Bhumbla CFO effective Sept 8, 2026. He joins from Tyson Foods’ Chicken unit; interim CFO Paul Kuehneman will resume VP, Controller and Principal Accounting Officer roles.
: Hormel Foods (HRL) yields about 4.9% and is listed among seven stocks with yields ≥4.7%. Coverage notes HRL's dividend yield and outlook tied to next year’s operating profits.
HRL SPAM Dog Launches In Minnesota

: HRL’s SPAM Dog launches at three OTG restaurants in Minneapolis–Saint Paul Airport through mid-September and debuts at the Minnesota State Fair Aug 27–Sept 7, with three Minnesota-flavored variants.
